description: This file defines a data class 'CartItem' representing an item in a shopping cart within an online shopping platform. It includes properties such as product ID, name, price, category, and quantity, along with validation in the initializer and a method to compute the subtotal.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: A data class modeling an item in the shopping cart, including validation and a method to calculate subtotal.

methods.name: subtotal
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total price for this cart item based on its unit price and quantity.
